episodes.synopsis: Natsuo's life suddenly becomes more complicated when his father comes home and announces he has remarried a woman with two daughters whom Natsuo has met before. They're Hina, his teacher and unrequited crush, and Rui, a girl he previously slept with.
episodes.title: Will You Do It With Me, Here?

episodes.synopsis: Natsuo has mixed feelings about a new classmate. Later, Hina receives a mysterious call that leaves her emotional and Natsuo concerned.
episodes.title: By Any Chance, Did We Do It?

episodes.synopsis: Natsuo learned the truth about Hina's mysterious relationship. Following an intense encounter with her, Natsuo leaves home to cool off and establishes a connection with Rui.
episodes.title: Is It True, After All?

episodes.synopsis: Determined to end Hina's affair, Natsuo and Rui take matters into their own hands. But things don't go according to plan.
episodes.title: And... What About You?

episodes.synopsis: Rui makes a new friend with a notorious reputation - and an uncomfortable attraction to Natsuo.
episodes.title: Is It Okay... If I Fall for Him?

episodes.synopsis: Crime doesn't pay and the punishment doesn't always fit the crime - a lesson Natsuo experiences firsthand after 'borrowing' a book from the library.
episodes.title: Right Here And Now, Try To Kiss

episodes.synopsis: Natsuo's perception of Hina changes when she reveals how she first met Shuu. Later, Rui comes to Natsuo with a surprising request - one he isn't sure he should fulfill.
episodes.title: This Is What It Means To Go Out Together, You Know?

episodes.synopsis: You can only lie to yourself for so long. As truths come bubbling to the surface, consequences ripple through Natsuo's entire household.
episodes.title: Then I don't have to be an adult

episodes.synopsis: Hina puts her plan to move out into motion. Neither Rui nor Natsuo wants her to leave, albeit for different reasons. Will their home feel the same without Hina in it?
episodes.title: Don't Say That, Please?

episodes.synopsis: Natsuo takes a tumble down a flight of stairs, but a broken leg is the least of his worries when he's caught in a lie by Rui.
episodes.title: Liar...

episodes.synopsis: Rui makes a decision after her conversation with Natsuo. Later, Natsuo's class takes a field trip to Okinawa, where feelings are laid bare beneath the light of fireworks.
episodes.title: Are You Sure?

episodes.synopsis: When the unthinkable happens, Hina expresses her love for Natsuo the only way she can: by giving him a chance to move on.
episodes.title: I'm Sorry, I Love You.
